source: Draft starter set — Claude, for Chris to edit/replace

cues.title: Torch eyes
cues.analogy: You've got a torch strapped to your head — it only lights up what it's pointed at. Keep swinging your torch around so you don't miss anything happening around you.
cues.usage: Prompt for scanning before receiving the ball.

cues.title: Quick peek
cues.cue: Take a peek before it arrives!
cues.analogy: Like checking your mirrors before you pull out in a car — have a quick look over your shoulder before the ball gets to you, not after.
cues.usage: Reminder to scan just before receiving a pass.

cues.title: Glue on your laces
cues.cue: Keep the ball glued to your laces!
cues.analogy: Imagine there's glue on your bootlaces and the ball — every touch should stick close, not bounce away.
cues.usage: Close control while dribbling under no/light pressure.

cues.title: Sewing machine feet
cues.analogy: Feet moving fast and small, like a sewing machine needle — lots of little touches, not one big kick.
cues.usage: Speeding up touches in tight spaces.

cues.title: Rock the bridge
cues.cue: Sell the fake — rock them off balance!
cues.analogy: You're rocking a bridge — get them leaning one way, then go the other while they're still wobbling.
cues.usage: Setting up a change of direction to beat a defender.

cues.title: Matador step
cues.cue: Let them run past — don't chase!
cues.analogy: Like a matador stepping aside from the bull — let the attacker run past you instead of diving in; use your body, not a lunge.
cues.usage: Defending 1v1 without committing to a tackle.

cues.title: Soft hands pass
cues.cue: Weight it like an egg, not a rock!
cues.analogy: Pass it like you're handing someone an egg, not throwing a rock at them — enough pace to get there, soft enough to control.
cues.usage: Judging pass weight to a nearby teammate.

cues.title: Follow your pass
cues.cue: Pass and move — don't stand and admire it!
cues.analogy: Like posting a letter — once it's gone, you don't stand at the postbox, you walk on to where you're needed next.
cues.usage: Encouraging movement off the ball after passing.

cues.title: Open book body shape
cues.analogy: Turn your body like you're opening a book, so you can see both the ball and the space you're passing into at the same time.
cues.usage: Body shape to receive on the half-turn.

cues.title: Traffic light decision
cues.cue: Red, amber, green — what's your light?
cues.analogy: Red = danger, stop or pass. Amber = be careful, shield it. Green = space ahead, go! A quick check of your 'traffic light' before deciding.
cues.usage: Fast decision-making on the ball under pressure.

cues.title: Honey, not vinegar
cues.analogy: Kind words are like honey — people want more of them. Blame is like vinegar — it makes people want to back away. Which one are you giving your teammates?
cues.usage: Reinforcing the teamwork behaviour principle after a mistake.

cues.title: Soft feet
cues.analogy: Move like you're tiptoeing across a creaky floor without waking anyone up — quick, light, quiet steps so you can change direction in an instant.
cues.usage: Footwork for evading taggers or defenders.

cues.title: Captain's voice
cues.cue: Call it early, call it loud!
cues.analogy: Be the captain of a ship shouting directions to the crew — clear and early, not a mumble after the wave's already hit.

cues.title: Brave first touch
cues.analogy: Like stepping off a busy road onto the pavement — your first touch should take the ball away from the nearest defender, into space.
